faq.question: What are the eligibility requirements and prerequisites for the AI Digital Marketing Strategist program?
faq.answer: The program requires basic computer literacy, internet navigation skills, and familiarity with spreadsheets (Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel). No prior programming experience, marketing degree, or commercial advertising background is required. The curriculum begins with business fundamentals before progressing into advanced paid media, analytics, and automation.

faq.question: How does the beginner-to-advanced learning pathway work over the 6 months?
faq.answer: The 6-month journey is divided into sequential phases: Month 1 focuses on business strategy, unit economics, and consumer psychology; Month 2 advances into semantic SEO, technical site crawls, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO); Month 3 covers brand systems, organic social operations, and Google Ads; Month 4 tackles Meta Ads, creative testing matrices, and GTM/GA4 analytics; Month 5 masters conversion rate optimization, HubSpot CRM, and n8n automation; and Month 6 is dedicated to media budgeting, agency operations, the comprehensive 90-day capstone project, and individual viva voce defense.

faq.question: What is the total duration and guided training hour commitment?
faq.answer: The program comprises exactly 240 guided instructional and laboratory training hours delivered over 6 calendar months across 11 structured modules (53 detailed lessons). In addition to guided class and lab time, students should expect to commit 6–8 hours per week to independent laboratory builds, tool configuration, and portfolio artifact development.

faq.question: What software tools and platforms will I learn hands-on?
faq.answer: You will master 15 core production platforms: Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Search Console, Looker Studio, Semrush, Screaming Frog SEO Spider, HubSpot CRM, n8n, Brevo, WordPress, ChatGPT, Google Gemini, and Canva. Supporting exposure includes Ahrefs, Microsoft Clarity, Meta Business Suite, Claude, Notion, and Adobe Firefly.

faq.question: How are modern AI tools integrated into the curriculum?
faq.answer: Artificial intelligence is taught as an operational accelerator with strict human-in-the-loop governance across all modules. You will learn enterprise prompt engineering (Role, Task, Context, Constraints), customer review mining, multi-angle copywriting, generative visual ideation, and conversational search evaluation (GEO for AI Overviews). We strictly emphasize fact-checking, hallucination mitigation, and copyright compliance, without promoting unverified autonomous spam.

faq.question: What is Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and how is it taught?
faq.answer: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) focuses on understanding how modern conversational answer engines—such as Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and Gemini—synthesize search results. You will learn entity mapping, structured data markup, and information gain principles to measure and improve brand citation presence. We teach realistic measurement methodologies without making unscientific promises of guaranteed AI citations.

faq.question: Do I need to spend my own money on paid advertising campaigns?
faq.answer: No. Nova Skills enforces a strict Zero-Student-Ad-Spend Policy. All advertising practicals in Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager are conducted in professional expert draft modes, sandbox accounts, and offline campaign builders (such as Google Ads Editor). You will build complete production-ready campaigns, targeting hierarchies, and creative matrices without risking personal financial capital.

faq.question: How are analytics, GTM conversion tracking, and attribution handled?
faq.answer: You will work with authorized sandbox websites, Google Tag Manager containers, and live Google Analytics 4 demo properties (such as the Google Merchandise Store). You will deploy custom event tags, verify triggers in Tag Assistant Preview mode, designate commercial Key Events, configure exploration funnels, and build interactive multi-channel Looker Studio dashboards calculating blended CPA and ROAS.

faq.question: What will I learn about CRM, lifecycle marketing, and marketing automation?
faq.answer: You will configure real CRM pipelines in HubSpot CRM, design 100-point behavioral lead scoring models, build automated email nurture sequences in Brevo, and construct no-code automation workflows in n8n connecting website form webhooks to CRM contact creation and notifications, complete with error-handling logic.

faq.question: What portfolio projects and capstone deliverable will I complete?
faq.answer: You will build 7 modular portfolio projects (SEO/GEO audit, brand content strategy, Google Ads plan, Meta Ads testing matrix, GTM/Looker Studio dashboard, CRM automation engine, and landing page CRO audit) plus a comprehensive 14-deliverable final capstone: a complete 90-Day Integrated Business Growth Strategy. You will also complete a timed technical troubleshooting laboratory exam and defend your work in an oral viva voce defense.

faq.question: Are the projects based on live or simulated client businesses?
faq.answer: Projects utilize a combination of live sandbox deployments (live WordPress landing pages, active GTM containers, real Looker Studio dashboards) and realistic simulated business scenarios based on real-world agency briefs. All student case studies are clearly documented with verified data inputs, ensuring total transparency and academic integrity.

faq.question: Do I need to pay for software subscriptions during the course?
faq.answer: No. All required hands-on practicals are designed to operate entirely within free software tiers, educational licenses, sandbox accounts, and authorized demo data streams (such as Google Merchandise Store GA4, Screaming Frog free mode, HubSpot free portal, and n8n community/cloud trials).

faq.question: What is the tuition fee and are there EMI options?
faq.answer: The tuition fee for the complete 6-month AI Digital Marketing Strategist program is ₹44,900 INR (applicable taxes/GST extra). Flexible monthly installment (EMI) options are available through approved academic banking partners subject to standard verification.

faq.question: What career transition and placement support is provided?
faq.answer: Nova Skills provides structured career coaching, resume optimization, LinkedIn profile reviews, mock technical interviews, and portfolio defense preparation. While we provide comprehensive portfolio verification that enables graduates to showcase rigorous proof-of-work to prospective employers and agency clients, we strictly refrain from making unrealistic guaranteed job or salary promises.

subtopics: On-page optimization: title tags, meta descriptions, URL slugs, and heading structures (H1-H4)
Semantic internal linking architecture: PageRank flow and contextual anchor text governance
E-E-A-T guidelines: demonstrating Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, and Trustworthiness
Image SEO: responsive compression, WebP formats, and descriptive alt attributes
Duplicate and thin-content audits: consolidation, canonicalization, and 301 redirect mapping
lessons.why_it_matters: On-page and internal link hygiene directly affects crawl depth, contextual understanding, click-through rates, and algorithmic ranking stability.
lessons.what_learner_does: Optimize a live WordPress landing page using Gutenberg blocks, inject targeted schema markup, and build a contextual internal linking matrix.
lessons.expected_outcome: Fully Optimized On-Page WordPress Asset & Internal Linking Matrix.

lessons.lesson_title: Technical SEO Auditing, Indexing & Core Web Vitals
lessons.what_is_taught: Technical SEO audits using Screaming Frog, crawl budget management, robots.txt and XML sitemaps, HTTP status codes, Core Web Vitals diagnostics, and JavaScript SEO basics.
subtopics: Technical SEO crawling and indexing mechanics: robots.txt directives and XML sitemaps
Diagnosing HTTP status codes (200, 301, 302, 404, 500) and resolving redirect chains
Canonicalization rules, self-referencing canonicals, and duplicate content mitigation
Core Web Vitals evaluation: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP), Interaction to Next Paint (INP), and Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS)
JavaScript SEO fundamentals: client-side rendering vs. server-side rendering implications
lessons.why_it_matters: Technical indexation barriers and poor page experience can neutralize exceptional content by preventing search engines from efficiently rendering high-value pages.
lessons.what_learner_does: Execute a 25-point technical site crawl using Screaming Frog, categorize errors by severity, and create an engineering remediation roadmap.
lessons.expected_outcome: 25-Point Technical SEO Crawl Audit & Remediation Roadmap.

lessons.lesson_title: Local SEO Domination & Google Business Profile Architecture
lessons.what_is_taught: Local search algorithms, Google Business Profile (GBP) optimization, Local 3-Pack ranking signals, NAP citation consistency, local structured data, and review management.
subtopics: Local search ranking factors: proximity, prominence, and relevance
Google Business Profile optimization: categories, services, products, and geotagged imagery
Local citation networks and Name-Address-Phone (NAP) consistency audits
Implementing Schema.org LocalBusiness and Organization structured data via JSON-LD
Reputation signals: review generation strategies and ethical review responses
lessons.why_it_matters: High-intent commercial queries frequently resolve in the Local 3-Pack, driving phone calls and qualified foot traffic with immediate revenue impact.
lessons.what_learner_does: Configure an optimized Google Business Profile blueprint and generate custom LocalBusiness JSON-LD schema markup with opening hours and geo-coordinates.
lessons.expected_outcome: Local SEO Optimization Package & Validated JSON-LD Schema Script.

lessons.lesson_title: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) & AI Search Intelligence
lessons.what_is_taught: AEO and GEO terminology, Google AI Overviews and AI Mode mechanics, source citation criteria, AI-search visibility measurement, digital PR, and Search Console reporting.
subtopics: AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) terminology
Google AI Overviews and conversational answer engines: citation mechanics and source quality
Measuring AI-search brand visibility and citation presence without false ranking promises
Digital PR and link acquisition fundamentals: brand mentions and unlinked citations
Google Search Console and GA4 SEO reporting: performance queries, impressions, and CTR trends
lessons.why_it_matters: Search is evolving into conversational synthesis; marketers must optimize for AI citations and direct answers while maintaining realistic, unhyped client expectations.
lessons.what_learner_does: Audit a target brand across Google AI Overviews, evaluate information gain, and formulate a 90-day SEO/GEO strategic improvement roadmap.
lessons.expected_outcome: Comprehensive 90-Day SEO/GEO Roadmap & Search Intelligence Audit.

modules.hands_on_practice: Complete an advanced technical and content SEO audit using Screaming Frog and Google Search Console, and prepare an evidence-based 90-day SEO and GEO improvement roadmap with verified schema markup.
modules.assignment: Deliverable 2.1: Technical SEO & GEO Roadmap Dossier (including 25-point crawl audit, topical cluster map, LocalBusiness schema JSON-LD, and AI Overviews visibility audit).
modules.business_application: Essential for organic search strategists, agency SEO directors, and in-house growth teams leading organic search modernization.
modules.expected_outcome: Production-ready technical audit report and strategic 90-day SEO/GEO execution roadmap.

lessons.lesson_title: Brand Positioning, Visual Systems & Brand Guidelines

subtopics: Brand positioning strategy: defining brand archetype, voice, tone, and commercial promises
Audience needs, customer emotional intent, and brand value proposition alignment
Visual identity systems: typography contrast, color psychology, and aspect ratio standards
Creating a digital brand style guide for cross-functional agency and freelance consistency
AI-assisted brand voice modeling: training AI on brand guidelines for tone fidelity

lessons.what_is_taught: Content marketing strategy, content pillar architecture, multi-platform publishing schedules, editorial calendar management, and content repurposing workflows.
subtopics: Designing core content pillars: Thought Leadership, Social Proof, Educational, and Direct Conversion
Multi-platform content strategy: tailoring content for Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, and YouTube
LinkedIn and B2B content fundamentals: executive thought leadership and company page growth
Editorial calendar governance in Notion: scheduling cadences, approval gates, and asset management
Content repurposing engines: converting 1 long-form asset into 8 multi-platform micro-assets

lessons.what_learner_does: Develop a structured 30-day multi-channel content calendar in Notion with designated content pillars, posting frequencies, and copy briefs.

subtopics: Direct-response copywriting frameworks: AIDA (Attention, Interest, Desire, Action) and PAS (Problem, Agitate, Solve)
Campaign hooks and visual storytelling: stopping thumb-scroll in the first 1.5 seconds
Multi-slide carousel architecture: hook slide, narrative pacing, value delivery, and CTA slide
AI-assisted creative ideation: generating headline variations and visual concept angles
Human creative review: evaluating AI-generated drafts for brand voice, factual accuracy, and punch
lessons.why_it_matters: High-performing creative assets are the primary lever for organic engagement and paid advertising efficiency in modern feed-based algorithms.
lessons.what_learner_does: Design a 7-slide educational carousel in Canva using AIDA framework with custom graphic layouts, contrast typography, and strong CTA.
lessons.expected_outcome: Production-Grade 7-Slide Social Carousel & Direct-Response Copy Suite.

lessons.lesson_title: Short-Form Video Strategy, Scripting & Reels Production
lessons.what_is_taught: Short-form video strategy across Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and TikTok, 3-second hook scripting, B-roll storyboarding, generative visual workflows, and editing mechanics.
subtopics: Short-form video strategy: algorithmic retention drivers across Reels and YouTube Shorts
Scripting short-form videos: 3-second hook, problem context, value payoff, and micro-conversion CTA
Storyboarding and visual asset sourcing: B-roll sequencing and caption styling
Generative image and video workflows: using Adobe Firefly for commercially compliant creative ideation
Platform-specific aspect ratios (9:16), audio selection, and on-screen text contrast rules

lessons.expected_outcome: Completed 45-Second Short-Form Video Reel & Production Storyboard.

lessons.lesson_title: Social Listening, Community Growth & Crisis Management
lessons.what_is_taught: Social media analytics, engagement rate benchmarking, audience sentiment tracking, influencer/creator collaboration agreements, community management, and crisis protocols.

Social listening: tracking brand mentions, customer sentiment, and competitor conversations
Influencer and creator collaborations: vetting creator audiences, deliverables, and FTC disclosure rules
Community engagement protocols: comment moderation, direct message nurturing, and customer support handoffs
Brand reputation protection and rapid-response crisis communication playbooks
lessons.why_it_matters: Audience growth requires active community nurturing and proactive crisis readiness to safeguard brand equity and customer goodwill.
lessons.what_learner_does: Conduct a social media performance audit, draft an influencer partnership brief, and establish a customer interaction response protocol.
lessons.expected_outcome: Social Media Performance Audit & Influencer Partnership Framework.

modules.expected_outcome: Complete 30-day organic social marketing campaign ready for multi-platform deployment.

modules.module_purpose: Architect scalable paid search acquisition systems, structuring Google Ads accounts to maximize commercial intent capture, control CPC bidding efficiency, and implement value-based bidding algorithms without budget waste.
what_you_will_learn: Structure multi-tier Google Ads account hierarchies, campaign types, and ad group architectures.
Execute high-intent Search campaigns with precision match-type governance and negative keyword hygiene.
Engineer high-Ad-Rank Responsive Search Ads (RSAs) and dynamic asset extensions aligned with landing page offers.
Deploy Performance Max (PMax), Demand Gen, and value-based bidding strategies while evaluating October 2026 AI Max controls.

lessons.lesson_title: Google Ads Architecture, Quality Score & Ad Rank Mechanics
lessons.what_is_taught: Google Ads account architecture, campaign types, auction economics, Ad Rank equation, Quality Score components, and comprehensive account auditing protocols.
subtopics: Google Ads account hierarchy: MCC, client accounts, campaigns, ad groups, and keywords
The Google Ads auction: Ad Rank formula (Bid × Quality Score × Ad Asset Impact)
Deconstructing Quality Score: Expected CTR, Ad Relevance, and Landing Page Experience
Account audits: identifying historical budget leaks, wasted spend, and ad group overlap
Google advertising policies, editorial guidelines, and compliance verification
lessons.why_it_matters: A high Quality Score reduces Cost Per Click (CPC) by up to 50% for identical positions, directly boosting advertising profitability.
lessons.what_learner_does: Perform a structured account audit on a sample Google Ads export, calculate Ad Rank scenarios, and identify Quality Score remediation opportunities.
lessons.expected_outcome: Google Ads Account Audit & Quality Score Remediation Blueprint.

lessons.lesson_title: High-Intent Search Campaign Structuring & Match Types
lessons.what_is_taught: Search campaign planning, keyword research with Google Keyword Planner, match type mechanics (Exact, Phrase, Broad with Smart Bidding), search terms reports, and negative keyword lists.
subtopics: Search campaign planning: Single-Theme Ad Groups (STAGs) and intent-tiered structures
Keyword match types: Exact match precision, Phrase match intent, and Broad match algorithmic discovery
Mining the Search Terms Report for high-converting queries and irrelevant search queries
Negative keyword lists: account-level, campaign-level, and ad-group-level negative hygiene
Budget pacing, shared budgets, and dayparting schedule optimization
lessons.why_it_matters: Rigorous keyword governance and negative filtering prevent irrelevant clicks, ensuring media budget is reserved exclusively for high-intent prospects.
lessons.what_learner_does: Structure a high-intent Google Search campaign in draft mode with 3 Single-Theme Ad Groups, match-type variations, and a 50-term negative keyword list.
lessons.expected_outcome: Google Search Campaign Architecture Blueprint & Negative Keyword Library.

lessons.lesson_title: Responsive Search Ad (RSA) Engineering & Asset Extensions
lessons.what_is_taught: Responsive Search Ad copywriting, pin management, headline diversity, asset extensions (sitelinks, callouts, structured snippets, lead forms), and landing page congruence.
subtopics: Responsive Search Ads (RSAs): 15 headlines and 4 descriptions diversity matrix
Headline pinning rules: when to pin for brand compliance vs. algorithmic freedom
Deploying high-impact Ad Assets: Sitelinks, Callout assets, Structured Snippets, and Call assets
Message match and landing-page relevance: ensuring headline-to-landing-page copy continuity
Ad strength metrics: interpreting 'Poor' to 'Excellent' ratings without blindly accepting automated suggestions
lessons.why_it_matters: Rich ad assets expand physical SERP real estate, boost expected CTR, and lower effective acquisition costs.
lessons.what_learner_does: Draft an RSA copywriting matrix with 15 differentiated headlines, 4 descriptions, and 4 sitelink extensions with descriptive copy.
lessons.expected_outcome: Responsive Search Ad Copywriting Matrix & Asset Extension Suite.

lessons.lesson_title: Bidding Strategies, Smart Bidding & Value-Based Optimization
lessons.what_is_taught: Google Ads bidding landscape, manual CPC with enhanced bidding, Smart Bidding algorithms (Maximize Clicks, Maximize Conversions, Target CPA, Target ROAS), and portfolio bidding.
subtopics: Manual vs. automated bidding: understanding data thresholds required for algorithmic learning
Smart Bidding strategies: Maximize Conversions vs. Target Cost Per Acquisition (tCPA)
Value-based bidding: Maximize Conversion Value vs. Target Return on Ad Spend (tROAS)
Portfolio bidding strategies and shared budget pacing across multiple campaigns
Campaign experiments (A/B testing bid strategies) and statistical confidence monitoring
lessons.why_it_matters: Smart Bidding leverages real-time auction signals to optimize bids for revenue rather than vanity clicks, maximizing bottom-line commercial return.
lessons.what_learner_does: Model target CPA and target ROAS scenarios based on client gross margins, and configure a Google Ads campaign experiment in draft mode.
lessons.expected_outcome: Smart Bidding Simulation & Campaign Experiment Configuration.

lessons.lesson_title: Performance Max (PMax) Architecture & Asset Group Strategy
lessons.what_is_taught: Performance Max campaign mechanics, inventory coverage (Search, YouTube, Display, Discover, Gmail, Maps), asset group engineering, audience signals, shopping feeds, and Demand Gen.
subtopics: Performance Max (PMax) mechanics: multi-channel inventory distribution and algorithmic asset assembly
Structuring PMax Asset Groups: image assets, video assets, headlines, and long descriptions
Audience signals: seeding machine learning with customer match lists, custom intent, and remarketing segments
Google Shopping fundamentals: product feed hygiene and Merchant Center integration basics
Demand Gen campaigns: visual storytelling on YouTube and Discover to generate top-of-funnel consideration
lessons.why_it_matters: PMax consolidates Google's entire ad ecosystem; mastering asset groups and audience signals is critical for modern multi-channel campaign scaling.
lessons.what_learner_does: Build a complete PMax Asset Group specification in draft mode, compiling 20 visual assets, 5 headlines, 5 descriptions, and targeted audience signal definitions.
lessons.expected_outcome: Performance Max Asset Group Specification & Audience Signal Blueprint.

lessons.lesson_title: Google Ads Troubleshooting, Auditing & Budget Control
lessons.what_is_taught: Conversion tracking validation, diagnosing campaign performance drops, scaling campaigns safely, evaluating automated Google recommendations, and executive client reporting.
subtopics: Validating conversion tracking tag fires and enhanced conversion data in Google Ads
Diagnosing performance anomalies: impression share loss due to budget vs. rank
Budget pacing: scaling daily budgets without resetting algorithmic machine learning phases
Critical evaluation of Google auto-apply recommendations and policy violation appeals
Automated client reporting: translating Google Ads metrics into business revenue outcomes
lessons.why_it_matters: Agency practitioners must protect client spend by filtering predatory automated recommendations and diagnosing performance issues before spend is wasted.
lessons.what_learner_does: Perform a diagnostic post-mortem on an underperforming campaign dataset, formulate a 5-step corrective action plan, and compile an executive report.
lessons.expected_outcome: Google Ads Diagnostic Remediation Plan & Executive Performance Report.

Build high-converting native Instant Lead Generation forms and explore B2B LinkedIn and emerging conversational ads.

lessons.lesson_title: Meta Advertising Ecosystem, ODAX & Auction Economics
lessons.what_is_taught: Meta advertising infrastructure, Business Manager asset structure, Meta ad auction mechanics (Total Value equation), ODAX objectives, and budget allocation (CBO/Advantage Campaign Budget vs. ABO).
subtopics: Meta Business Manager, Ad Accounts, Pixels, Catalogs, and Page asset permissions
Meta ad auction formula: Total Value = Bid × Estimated Action Rate + User Value
ODAX (Outcome-Driven Ad Experiences) campaign objectives: Awareness, Traffic, Engagement, Leads, App Promotion, Sales
Advantage Campaign Budget (CBO) vs. Ad Set Budget (ABO): when to use each for scaling
Meta advertising policies, special ad categories (Housing, Credit, Employment), and compliance
lessons.why_it_matters: Aligning campaign objectives with Meta's machine learning optimization engines ensures media spend is delivered to users most likely to execute high-value commercial actions.
lessons.what_learner_does: Set up a complete Meta campaign structure in draft mode, selecting appropriate ODAX objectives, budget configurations, and compliance parameters.

lessons.what_is_taught: Audience targeting strategies, Custom Audiences from first-party data, Lookalike Audiences, Advantage+ audience expansion, broad targeting mechanics, and audience exclusion hygiene.
subtopics: First-party data Custom Audiences: customer list uploads, website traffic, and video viewers
Lookalike Audiences: source quality, percentage sizing (1% to 10%), and current availability trends
Advantage+ audience automation: trusting algorithmic targeting vs. setting audience suggestions and exclusions
Broad targeting methodology: allowing creative assets to define the target audience
Audience overlap and fatigue: checking audience overlap in Meta Business Suite to avoid self-competition
lessons.why_it_matters: Proper audience segmentation and overlap management prevent ad fatigue and auction self-bidding, lowering acquisition costs across all funnel stages.
lessons.what_learner_does: Map a full-funnel Meta audience architecture in draft mode, defining prospecting, middle-funnel engagement, and bottom-funnel remarketing audiences.
lessons.expected_outcome: Meta Full-Funnel Audience Architecture & Exclusion Matrix.

subtopics: Creative strategy as targeting: designing visuals and copy that attract buyers and repel non-buyers
The 3×3 creative testing framework: testing 3 unique visual hooks across 3 copy angles
Static image design vs. motion graphics vs. user-generated content (UGC) ad formats
Creative fatigue diagnosis: identifying frequency spikes, CTR drops, and rising Cost Per Action
Iterative creative scaling: isolating winning hooks and generating modular creative variations
lessons.why_it_matters: In automated broad-targeting environments, creative is the primary driver of ad performance; rigorous creative testing separates winning campaigns from unprofitable spend.
lessons.what_learner_does: Design a 3×3 creative testing suite in Canva featuring 3 visual styles and 3 direct-response copy variations (Pain-Point, Benefit-Driven, Social Proof).
lessons.expected_outcome: Meta 3×3 Creative Testing Suite & Ad Copy Matrix.

lessons.lesson_title: Native Instant Lead Generation Forms & WhatsApp Funnels

subtopics: Native Instant Forms architecture: intro screens, custom question fields, and completion cards
Higher Intent forms (review step) vs. More Volume forms: balancing lead quantity against lead quality
Custom qualification filtering: screening leads before they enter the CRM database
Direct-to-WhatsApp messaging ads: structuring conversational lead qualification funnels
Meta Pixel and Conversions API (CAPI) concepts: understanding server-side data dispatch

lessons.lesson_title: Multi-Channel B2B Social & Emerging Ad Platforms

B2B targeting parameters: Job Function, Seniority, Company Size, Industry, and Member Skills

Cross-channel measurement and audience deduplication between Meta and LinkedIn
Emerging conversational ad platforms: conceptual overview of ChatGPT Ads and sponsored answer considerations

what_you_will_learn: Instrument custom tracking tags, triggers, and variables in Google Tag Manager and verify in Tag Assistant.

lessons.lesson_title: GA4 Architecture, Data Streams & Event-Driven Models
lessons.what_is_taught: GA4 measurement paradigm, data streams (Web vs. App), session-based vs. event-based tracking models, automatically collected events, enhanced measurement, and account configuration.
subtopics: GA4 measurement paradigm: understanding event-based architectures vs. legacy session hit models
Configuring web data streams, Measurement IDs, and data retention windows (2 vs. 14 months)
Automatically collected events vs. Enhanced Measurement (scrolls, outbound clicks, site search, video engagement)
Recommended events and custom event taxonomy governance: naming conventions and parameter hygiene
User identification: Blended vs. Observed reporting identities (User ID, Google Signals, Device-based)
lessons.why_it_matters: A properly structured GA4 foundation ensures complete data capture without polluting reporting views with malformed event names and duplicate parameters.
lessons.what_learner_does: Configure a sandbox GA4 property, establish custom parameter definitions, and author an agency event taxonomy naming convention document.
lessons.expected_outcome: GA4 Property Architecture Specification & Event Taxonomy Standard.

lessons.lesson_title: Google Tag Manager Deployment & Custom Event Tracking
lessons.what_is_taught: Google Tag Manager container architecture, tag-trigger-variable mechanics, built-in vs. user-defined variables, tracking clicks, form submissions, and debugging with Tag Assistant.
subtopics: GTM container architecture: Account -> Container -> Workspace governance and version control
Tags, Triggers, and Variables: built-in variables, DOM elements, Click Classes, and Form IDs
Deploying GA4 Configuration and GA4 Event tags with dynamic event parameters
Debugging in Tag Assistant Preview mode: inspecting dataLayer pushes, trigger evaluations, and tag fire status
Exporting and importing GTM container JSON configurations for reproducible agency deployments
lessons.why_it_matters: GTM gives marketers the autonomy to deploy sophisticated behavioral tracking without relying on developer sprint cycles or editing website code directly.
lessons.what_learner_does: Deploy 4 custom GA4 event tags in GTM (Button Click, Form Submit, Video View, Scroll Depth) and verify tag firings in Tag Assistant Preview mode.
lessons.expected_outcome: Exported GTM Container JSON & Tag Assistant QA Verification Log.

lessons.lesson_title: Conversion Tracking, Key Events & Audience Building
lessons.what_is_taught: Designating Key Events in GA4, importing Key Events into Google Ads, Meta Pixel and Conversions API integration concepts, enhanced conversions, and building remarketing audiences.
subtopics: Designating Key Events (formerly Conversions) in GA4 and mapping to commercial business goals
Linking GA4 with Google Ads and importing Key Events for bidding optimization
Enhanced conversions in Google Ads: hashing first-party data for conversion recovery
Meta Pixel base code and Conversions API (CAPI) concepts: event deduplication via event_id
Building predictive and behavioral audiences in GA4 for Google Ads campaign activation

lessons.what_learner_does: Designate 2 custom Key Events in GA4, link Google Ads sandbox, and build a 30-day high-intent purchaser remarketing audience.
lessons.expected_outcome: GA4 Key Event Architecture & Cross-Platform Audience Blueprint.

lessons.lesson_title: Advanced GA4 Exploration Reports & User Journey Analysis
lessons.what_is_taught: Building custom exploration reports in GA4, Funnel Exploration, Path Exploration, Free Form tables, cohort analysis, and diagnosing drop-offs across acquisition channels.
subtopics: Funnel Exploration: creating open vs. closed multi-step checkout and lead capture drop-off funnels
Path Exploration: reverse-engineering user navigation journeys leading to Key Events
Free Form exploration tables: multi-dimensional breakdown using secondary dimensions and calculated metrics
Cohort Exploration: analyzing user retention and conversion velocity over time
Traffic acquisition analysis: evaluating organic, direct, referral, and paid campaign performance
lessons.why_it_matters: Standard GA4 reports offer high-level summaries; custom Explorations reveal the exact micro-drop-off moments in customer journeys where revenue is lost.
lessons.what_learner_does: Build an executive Funnel Exploration and a Path Exploration in GA4 analyzing user drop-offs from landing page visit to form completion.
lessons.expected_outcome: GA4 Multi-Step Funnel Exploration & Path Analysis Report.

lessons.lesson_title: Multi-Touch Attribution & Looker Studio Executive Dashboards

UTM parameter governance: source, medium, campaign, content, and term taxonomy standard

Looker Studio engineering: connecting GA4, Google Search Console, and Google Sheets data sources
Creating calculated metrics in Looker Studio: blended CPA, ROAS, conversion rates, and MER
Executive performance storytelling: presenting marketing metrics clearly to non-technical stakeholders
lessons.why_it_matters: Connecting multi-channel data into an automated executive dashboard transforms fragmented numbers into clear business intelligence that guides budget decisions.
lessons.what_learner_does: Build an interactive, single-page Looker Studio dashboard connecting live GA4 data, calculating blended CPA and ROAS with date-range filters.
lessons.expected_outcome: Interactive Looker Studio Multi-Channel Executive Marketing Dashboard.

Landing Page Visual Hierarchy & Trust Architecture

lessons.lesson_title: CRO Foundations, Heuristic Frameworks & The LIFT Model
lessons.what_is_taught: Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) fundamentals, conversion psychology, heuristic evaluation frameworks, the LIFT Model (Value Proposition, Relevance, Clarity, Urgency, Anxiety, Distraction), and customer friction analysis.
subtopics: CRO economic fundamentals: compounding impact of conversion rate increases on blended CAC and ROAS
Conversion psychology: dual-process cognition (System 1 vs. System 2) in purchasing decisions
The LIFT Model evaluation: Value Proposition, Relevance, Clarity, Urgency, Anxiety, and Distraction
Landing page information hierarchy: Above-the-Fold architecture, eye-tracking F-patterns, and Z-patterns
Cognitive friction analysis: identifying unnecessary form fields, ambiguous CTAs, and confusing navigation
lessons.why_it_matters: A 50% increase in landing page conversion rate cuts effective customer acquisition costs in half without requiring an extra penny in advertising spend.
lessons.what_learner_does: Conduct a heuristic evaluation of an e-commerce or lead generation landing page using the 6-factor LIFT Model, cataloging friction points and conversion blockers.
lessons.expected_outcome: Heuristic LIFT Model Landing Page Evaluation Dossier.

lessons.lesson_title: Behavioral UX Research: Heatmaps & Session Replays
lessons.what_is_taught: Behavioral analytics using Microsoft Clarity, click heatmaps, scroll depth tracking, session recording interpretation, detecting rage-clicks, dead clicks, and funnel abandonment diagnostics.
subtopics: Deploying Microsoft Clarity tracking code and configuring custom user tags
Analyzing click heatmaps: identifying high-attention zones vs. unclicked dead elements
Scroll depth tracking: determining the average drop-off point and optimal CTA placement depth
Session recording diagnostics: spotting user confusion, rage-clicks, excessive scrolling, and broken interactions
Synthesizing qualitative user behavior with quantitative GA4 drop-off data
lessons.why_it_matters: Session recordings reveal the unvarnished reality of how actual users interact with pages, exposing invisible bugs and friction that quantitative analytics miss.
lessons.what_learner_does: Review 10 Microsoft Clarity session recordings and 3 heatmaps, identify 5 critical user friction behaviors, and document them in an evidence-backed UX audit.
lessons.expected_outcome: Behavioral UX Audit & Microsoft Clarity Heatmap Diagnostic Report.

lessons.lesson_title: High-Converting Landing Page Design & Copy Architecture
lessons.what_is_taught: Conversion-focused landing page design, copywriting architecture (Hero section, Problem/Solution, Features vs. Benefits, Social Proof, Risk Reversal), trust signals, lead form optimization, and mobile responsive UX.
subtopics: Hero section architecture: compelling benefit-driven headline, sub-headline, primary CTA, and social proof snippet
Trust signal engineering: badges, customer reviews, media logos, SSL security, and money-back guarantees
Form optimization: single-column layouts, smart field defaults, inline validation, and multi-step form mechanics
Mobile conversion optimization: sticky CTAs, touch-target sizing (48px+), and speed-focused lightweight assets
Building conversion landing pages in WordPress using native Gutenberg blocks
lessons.why_it_matters: A high-converting landing page is the commercial fulcrum where paid traffic transforms into registered leads and paying customers.
lessons.what_learner_does: Build and publish a responsive, conversion-optimized campaign landing page in WordPress using Gutenberg blocks with custom lead form and trust architecture.
lessons.expected_outcome: Live Responsive WordPress Campaign Landing Page URL & Layout Specification.

lessons.lesson_title: A/B Split Testing Methodology & Statistical Significance
lessons.what_is_taught: A/B split testing principles, hypothesis formulation (If/Then/Because), sample size calculation, statistical significance (p-value, 95% confidence threshold), experiment prioritization (ICE/PIE), and post-test reporting.
subtopics: A/B testing methodology: control vs. variant, isolated single-variable tests vs. radical redesigns
Writing rigorous test hypotheses: 'If we [change], then [metric will increase], because [psychological rationale]'
Sample size calculation and test duration modeling: avoiding premature test termination and false positives
Interpreting statistical significance (95% confidence interval) and minimum detectable effect (MDE)
Prioritization frameworks: ranking CRO experiment backlog using ICE (Impact, Confidence, Ease) scoring
Post-test documentation: cataloging learnings from winning, losing, and inconclusive experiments
lessons.why_it_matters: Disciplined testing methodology prevents companies from making harmful website changes based on flawed data, personal opinions, or statistical noise.
lessons.what_learner_does: Formulate 3 rigorous A/B test hypotheses, calculate required sample size using online calculators, and rank experiments using the ICE framework.
lessons.expected_outcome: Prioritized CRO Experimentation Backlog & A/B Test Plan.

faq.question: Is this course suitable for complete beginners with no prior marketing experience?
faq.answer: Yes. AI Digital Marketing Specialist is designed specifically for beginners, college students, career switchers, and junior marketing executives. There are no prerequisites other than basic computer and internet literacy. All marketing fundamentals, advertising platforms, and technical concepts are taught step-by-step from scratch.

faq.question: What is the course duration and weekly schedule?
faq.answer: The course runs for 3 Months (12 teaching weeks), delivering exactly 120 guided hours of instructor-led training, live platform walkthroughs, and supervised practical labs (targeting 10 guided hours per week).

faq.question: How much independent practice is expected outside guided training?
faq.answer: We recommend 40 to 60 additional hours of independent practice over the 12 weeks (approximately 3 to 5 hours per week). This time is dedicated to self-paced tool navigation, creative variations, portfolio documentation, and project refinement.

faq.question: Which software tools and platforms will I learn to practical proficiency?
faq.answer: You will develop practical proficiency in core platforms: Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, Canva, ChatGPT, and Google Gemini. You also gain working proficiency in supporting tools including Google Keyword Planner, Google Trends, Google Business Profile, WordPress, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, Meta Business Suite, and Brevo, plus introductory exposure to Semrush, Microsoft Clarity, and Adobe Firefly.

faq.question: What practical projects will I build for my professional portfolio?
faq.answer: You will build 5 tangible portfolio projects: (1) an SEO Audit & Keyword Research Project, (2) a Social Media Content Campaign, (3) a Google & Meta Advertising Setup, (4) a Conversion Landing Page & Tracking Exercise, and (5) an Integrated Local Business Digital Marketing Capstone. These assets form an employer-ready portfolio demonstrating verified proof-of-work.

faq.question: How is AI integrated into the digital marketing curriculum?
faq.answer: AI is integrated as a practical productivity copilot across all modules. You learn structured prompt engineering in ChatGPT and Gemini for buyer persona research, copywriting variations (AIDA/PAS), search intent clustering, and email drafting. You also learn human verification protocols and ethical guidelines to ensure high-quality, commercially compliant marketing output.

faq.question: Do I need to spend my own money on ad budgets or paid software subscriptions?
faq.answer: No. Nova Skills strictly enforces a Zero-Student-Ad-Spend Policy. All paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager are built in authorized draft modes, sandbox accounts, or offline simulation workbooks. No personal credit cards or ad spending are required. Furthermore, all software used in student labs utilizes free tiers or educational sandboxes.

faq.question: What tools use demonstration properties or authorized simulations?
faq.answer: Google's public GA4 demo account is used for report exploration and traffic analysis, while editable event tagging and Google Tag Manager exercises are conducted on student WordPress sandbox sites. Advanced enterprise SEO tools (Semrush/Ahrefs) are demonstrated via instructor walkthroughs and free exploratory features, ensuring you understand their commercial value without paying $130+/month subscriptions.

faq.question: How are students evaluated for certification?
faq.answer: Certification is evaluated based on practical project deliverables (50%), the integrated capstone portfolio (20%), a timed technical troubleshooting examination (15%), and an oral viva voce defense (15%). Completing these requirements with passing grades awards the Certified AI Digital Marketing Specialist credential.

faq.question: What placement support is provided after graduation?
faq.answer: Students receive dedicated placement assistance, including portfolio reviews, resume optimization for entry-level digital marketing roles, LinkedIn profile enhancement, and interview preparation drills. While we provide active placement support and connect graduates with hiring opportunities, Nova Skills does not make false promises of guaranteed jobs or immediate freelancing wealth.

faq.question: What job roles can I apply for after completing this program?
faq.answer: Graduates are prepared for entry-level digital marketing roles such as Digital Marketing Executive, Junior SEO Executive, Social Media Marketing Executive, Junior Paid Ads Executive, and Digital Marketing Assistant. The curriculum focuses on foundational execution rather than senior management or full-funnel corporate strategy.

modules.hands_on_practice: Create a customer persona, competitor analysis, and marketing funnel for a real or realistic local business.
modules.assignment: Deliverable 1.1: Customer Persona & Competitor Research Dossier (including 2 buyer personas, competitor ad analysis, and funnel map).
modules.business_application: Directly applicable to market research, client discovery, campaign scoping, and strategic positioning in agency and corporate marketing teams.
modules.expected_outcome: Validated client-ready customer research, competitive dossier, and campaign brief portfolio artifact.

modules.module_title: SEO, Local SEO & AI Search Fundamentals
modules.module_purpose: Impart durable, search-engine-compliant organic optimization skills across on-page, local, and basic technical SEO, alongside an evidence-based introduction to AI Overviews and Search Generative Experience (AEO/GEO).
what_you_will_learn: Understand search engine crawling, rendering, indexing, and ranking algorithms.
Conduct keyword research, search intent clustering, and site-wide keyword mapping.
Execute on-page optimization: title tags, meta descriptions, headings, and internal linking.
Diagnose website health using Google Search Console and inspect Core Web Vitals.
Optimize Google Business Profile and local search visibility using NAP consistency and local schema.
Apply evidence-based optimization for AI Overviews and conversational search without unscientific ranking gimmicks.

lessons.what_is_taught: How search engines discover, crawl, render, index, and rank web pages, including robots directives and sitemaps.
subtopics: Search engine architecture: Discovery, crawling, rendering, indexing, and ranking pipelines
Robots exclusion protocol (`robots.txt`) and XML sitemaps (`sitemap.xml`)
Understanding search intent taxonomy: Navigational, Informational, Commercial, Transactional
SERP feature analysis: Organic snippets, Featured Snippets, Knowledge Panels, and People Also Ask
lessons.why_it_matters: Content cannot rank if search engine bots are blocked or unable to render and index pages properly.
lessons.what_learner_does: Inspect and validate a website's `robots.txt` and XML sitemap, identifying crawl barriers and indexing directives.

lessons.what_is_taught: Systematic keyword discovery, search volume estimation, competition analysis, and clustering queries by user intent.
subtopics: Keyword research methodology: Volume, Keyword Difficulty (KD), intent alignment, and business value
Head terms vs. long-tail keywords: Conversion rate dynamics and intent specificity
Keyword clustering workflows using Google Keyword Planner, Google Suggest, and Gemini
Constructing a hierarchical site Keyword Map (URL-to-Keyword intent assignment)
lessons.why_it_matters: Prevents keyword cannibalization and ensures every target page on a website answers a distinct commercial or informational user query.
lessons.what_learner_does: Perform keyword research for a local service website, clustering 15+ keywords across 5 distinct target URLs with primary and secondary search terms.
lessons.expected_outcome: Multi-Page Keyword Map Spreadsheet with Intent Classification.

lessons.lesson_title: On-Page SEO, Content Optimization & Internal Linking
lessons.what_is_taught: Practical on-page content optimization, metadata copywriting, semantic heading hierarchy, and internal linking structures.
subtopics: Title tag architecture, meta description copywriting, and URL slug optimization rules
Semantic heading hierarchy (`H1`, `H2`, `H3`) and structural content organization
Topical depth, keyword density myths, and natural semantic keyword placement
Image SEO: Descriptive filenames, alt text accessibility, and modern WebP compression
Internal linking architecture: Hub-and-spoke models, contextual anchors, and link equity flow
lessons.why_it_matters: Proper on-page formatting and internal linking directly communicate page relevance and topical authority to search ranking algorithms.
lessons.what_learner_does: Draft and optimize title tags, meta descriptions, heading structures, image alt text, and internal link anchors across 5 web pages.

lessons.what_is_taught: Configuring, verifying, and navigating Google Search Console, diagnosing indexing errors, and understanding Core Web Vitals.
subtopics: Google Search Console setup and verification methods (DNS, HTML tag, GA4 link)
Analyzing the GSC Performance Report: Queries, Pages, Impressions, Clicks, CTR, Average Position
Diagnosing crawl issues via the Page Indexing report and URL Inspection Tool
Core Web Vitals introduction: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP), Interaction to Next Paint (INP), Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS)
lessons.why_it_matters: Search Console is Google's authoritative direct communication channel for technical indexing health, manual actions, and actual search impressions.
lessons.what_learner_does: Inspect live/diagnostic Search Console performance data, identify non-indexed URLs, run URL Inspection tests, and review Core Web Vitals status.
lessons.expected_outcome: Search Console Technical Audit & Performance Interpretation Report.

lessons.lesson_title: Local SEO, Google Business Profile & Evidence-Based AI Search
lessons.what_is_taught: Local search ranking factors, Google Business Profile optimization, NAP citation consistency, and evidence-based AI search visibility.
subtopics: Google Business Profile (GBP) configuration: Categories, business attributes, services, photos, and reviews
Local 3-Pack ranking signals: Relevance, Distance, and Prominence
NAP (Name, Address, Phone) citation consistency and local directory syndication
Local business structured data: `LocalBusiness` JSON-LD schema generation
Evidence-based Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
How Google AI Overviews and Gemini-powered search extract citations: factual authority, clarity, and structured entities
Scientific debunking of 'guaranteed AI ranking shortcuts' and fraudulent SEO claims
lessons.why_it_matters: Local businesses rely on local pack visibility and authentic citations for physical foot-traffic and inbound telephone enquiries.
lessons.what_learner_does: Conduct a local SEO audit for a local business, optimize GBP details, generate LocalBusiness JSON-LD schema, and evaluate AI Overview visibility.
lessons.expected_outcome: Local SEO Audit, Google Business Profile Optimization Plan & Schema Markup File.

modules.hands_on_practice: Build a keyword map, execute a five-page SEO optimization plan, perform a basic technical audit, and complete a local SEO analysis.
modules.assignment: Student Deliverable 1: Comprehensive SEO Audit & Keyword Map Document (including 5-page on-page optimization, GSC diagnostic findings, and local SEO action plan).
modules.business_application: Essential for junior SEO executives, local business consultants, and content marketers seeking organic search customer acquisition.
modules.expected_outcome: Complete multi-tab SEO audit, keyword intent map, and local optimization dossier for professional client presentations.

modules.module_title: Social Media Marketing, Content & AI Creatives
modules.module_purpose: Develop end-to-end competency in organic social media management, brand visual systems, conversion copywriting, short-form video concepts, and generative AI creative workflows.
what_you_will_learn: Select and prioritize social platforms based on audience demographics and engagement behavior.
Build structured monthly and weekly editorial content calendars using content pillars.
Apply direct-response copywriting frameworks, compelling hooks, and actionable CTAs.
Design brand visual systems, static advertising graphics, and multi-slide carousels in Canva.
Script, storyboard, and edit high-engagement short-form videos (Reels/Shorts).
Leverage ChatGPT and Gemini for AI-assisted ideation, creative variations, and ethical commercial usage.

lessons.lesson_title: Platform Selection, Audience Dynamics & Meta Business Suite
lessons.what_is_taught: Social media channel dynamics, algorithm engagement signals across Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn, and centralized business management.
subtopics: Platform demographics and user behavior: Instagram (visual/lifestyle), Facebook (community/local), LinkedIn (B2B/professional)
Organic distribution mechanics: Watch time, completion rate, saves, shares, and comment sentiment
Centralized social operations using Meta Business Suite: Linking pages, scheduling, unified messaging, and basic insights
Setting up and managing official Facebook Pages and Instagram Professional accounts
lessons.why_it_matters: Executing on the wrong platform or mismanaging posting workflows wastes operational hours without building a qualified audience.
lessons.what_learner_does: Configure an Instagram Professional and Facebook Business profile, exploring Meta Business Suite scheduling and audience insights tools.
lessons.expected_outcome: Social Platform Setup & Business Suite Configuration Audit.

lessons.lesson_title: Content Strategy, Editorial Calendars & Brand Voice
lessons.what_is_taught: Strategic content categorization, the 80/20 balance between value and promotion, editorial calendar structuring, and brand voice guidelines.
subtopics: Defining Content Pillars: Educational, Entertaining, Inspiring, and Promotional mixes
Building 14-day and 30-day editorial content calendars with clear asset formats and posting cadence
Developing brand voice guidelines, tone adaptability, and visual consistency rules
Community management fundamentals: Response protocols, comment moderation, and customer inquiry routing
lessons.why_it_matters: Consistent, structured content calendars prevent sporadic posting and establish brand credibility in competitive feeds.
lessons.what_learner_does: Build a comprehensive 14-day multi-channel editorial calendar covering 4 content pillars with post captions, format specs, and scheduled publication dates.

lessons.what_is_taught: Proven direct-response copywriting formulas, feed-stopping hook writing, and conversion-focused call-to-action engineering.
subtopics: Direct-response copywriting frameworks: AIDA (Attention, Interest, Desire, Action), PAS (Problem, Agitate, Solve), BAB (Before, After, Bridge)
Crafting high-engagement hooks for social feeds and video scripts (the 3-second attention rule)
Headline formulas, curiosity gaps, and benefit-driven copywriting
Call to Action (CTA) hierarchy: Engagement CTAs vs. Conversion CTAs (driving comments, saves, bio clicks, DMs)
lessons.why_it_matters: Visuals capture attention, but persuasive copy and clear CTAs convert casual viewers into engaged followers and paying customers.
lessons.what_learner_does: Write 6 sets of multi-angle social copy using AIDA and PAS frameworks, testing 3 distinct headline hooks and CTAs for each.
lessons.expected_outcome: Multi-Angle Social Copywriting Deck with Tested Hooks & CTAs.

lessons.lesson_title: Visual Design Systems & Canva Ad Creatives
lessons.what_is_taught: Visual hierarchy, typography pairing, color contrast, brand kit setup, and commercial creative production using Canva.
subtopics: Core graphic design principles: Visual hierarchy, whitespace, focal points, and typographic contrast
Canva Brand Kit setup: Color palettes, brand fonts, logo assets, and style guide enforcement
Designing high-CTR static social posts and multi-slide carousel sequences (1080x1080 and 1080x1350)
Designing vertical advertising creatives for Stories and Reels (1080x1920 safe zones)
lessons.why_it_matters: Professional visual assets distinguish legitimate businesses from low-quality spam in modern high-density feeds.
lessons.what_learner_does: Design 8 production-grade social creatives in Canva, including at least 2 multi-slide educational carousels and 2 vertical promotional assets.
lessons.expected_outcome: Suite of 8 Production-Ready Canva Creatives & Brand Styleboard.

lessons.lesson_title: Short-Form Video Production & Generative AI Creatives
lessons.what_is_taught: Short-form video anatomy, mobile editing workflows, AI-assisted ideation, and responsible commercial generative AI workflows.
subtopics: Anatomy of high-converting short-form videos (Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok)
Scriptwriting, pacing, visual B-roll planning, on-screen text overlays, and audio trends
Mobile video editing fundamentals: Cuts, transitions, captioning, and hook pacing
AI-assisted creative ideation using ChatGPT and Gemini for viral angles and video scripts
Introductory generative image workflows (Adobe Firefly / Canva Magic Studio free credits): Prompting, inpainting, background fill
Commercial compliance, copyright safety, and quality control in generative AI assets
lessons.why_it_matters: Short-form vertical video is the dominant organic growth engine across social platforms in 2026/27.
lessons.what_learner_does: Script and storyboard 4 short-video concepts, producing and editing at least 1 completed 30-second mobile reel with captions and hooks.
lessons.expected_outcome: Four Short-Form Video Concepts & One Fully Edited Mobile Reel.

modules.hands_on_practice: Develop a 14-day content calendar, design eight social creatives, and produce four short-video concepts or completed edited reels.
modules.assignment: Student Deliverable 3: Multi-Channel Social Media Campaign Portfolio (14-day calendar, 8 polished Canva creatives, and 4 short-form video scripts/reels).
modules.business_application: Prepares graduates to take immediate ownership of social media accounts, organic content production, and AI-assisted creative workflows.
modules.expected_outcome: Complete commercial social media creative portfolio asset demonstrating copywriting, visual design, and video competence.

modules.module_purpose: Master the mechanics, architectures, bidding strategies, policy constraints, and execution of paid search (Google Ads) and paid social (Meta Ads) advertising without risking personal student capital.
what_you_will_learn: Understand paid advertising auction economics, Ad Rank, Quality Score, and commercial KPI calculations.
Build Google Search campaign architectures with proper ad groups, keyword match types, and negative lists.
Write high-relevance Responsive Search Ads (RSAs) and configure ad assets (sitelinks, callouts).
Analyze search term reports and grasp introductory Performance Max (PMax) and AI Max for Search.
Structure Meta Ads Manager campaigns using ODAX objectives, ad sets, placements, and audience targeting.
Create native Meta instant lead generation forms and apply platform advertising compliance policies.

lessons.lesson_title: Paid Advertising Ecosystem, Auction Economics & Account Governance
lessons.what_is_taught: The paid media landscape, search intent vs. interruption social advertising, auction bidding mechanics, and account governance.
subtopics: Paid advertising ecosystem: Pull marketing (Google Search intent) vs. Push marketing (Meta feed discovery)
Auction models and Ad Rank mechanics: Max CPC bid x Quality Score + Expected Impact of Assets
Deconstructing Quality Score: Expected CTR, Ad Relevance, and Landing Page Experience
Core economic KPI calculations: CPM, CPC, CTR, Conversion Rate, CPL, CPA, and ROAS
Account governance: Google Ads MCC vs. Individual Accounts; Meta Business Portfolio / Manager vs. Personal Ad Accounts
lessons.why_it_matters: Understanding auction math prevents marketers from overbidding on low-intent terms or delivering poor ad experiences that inflate acquisition costs.
lessons.what_learner_does: Calculate Ad Rank, CPC, and ROAS across 3 simulated bidding auction scenarios and map business manager user permissions.
lessons.expected_outcome: Paid Advertising Auction Economics & Account Governance Worksheet.

lessons.lesson_title: Google Search Campaign Architecture, RSAs & Match Types
lessons.what_is_taught: Structuring Google Search campaigns, ad groups, keyword match types, negative keyword hygiene, and responsive search ads.
subtopics: Campaign hierarchy: Account -> Campaign -> Ad Groups -> Keywords & Ads
Keyword Match Types: Broad Match, Phrase Match, and Exact Match mechanics in 2026
Negative Keyword Lists: Account-level, campaign-level, and ad-group-level negative keyword hygiene
Responsive Search Ads (RSA): Formulating 15 diverse headlines, 4 descriptions, and strategic pinning logic
Ad Assets (Extensions): Sitelinks, Callouts, Structured Snippets, Call Assets, and Lead Form assets
Search Term Report analysis: Mining high-converting search queries and pruning budget-wasting terms
lessons.why_it_matters: Properly grouped search campaigns with disciplined negative keyword lists achieve higher Quality Scores and significantly lower cost per click.
lessons.what_learner_does: Build a complete Google Search campaign in draft mode with 2 tightly themed ad groups, match-typed keywords, 1 negative list, 1 full RSA, and 3 ad assets.
lessons.expected_outcome: Google Search Campaign Architecture Blueprint & Draft Ad Group Setup.

lessons.lesson_title: Bidding Fundamentals, Conversion Actions, AI Max & PMax
lessons.what_is_taught: Bidding strategy selection, daily budget pacing, Google conversion actions, and introductory AI Max and Performance Max (PMax).
subtopics: Bidding strategy selection: Manual CPC vs. Smart Bidding (Maximize Clicks, Maximize Conversions, Target CPA, Target ROAS)
Budget controls, daily pacing, delivery methods, and shared budget logic
Google Ads Conversion Actions: Primary vs. Secondary actions and conversion tracking linking
Introduction to Performance Max (PMax): Cross-network inventory, asset groups, audience signals, and required exclusions
Introduction to AI Max for Search: Dynamic headlines/descriptions, final URL expansion, and required brand exclusions
lessons.why_it_matters: Smart bidding algorithms require clean conversion data and strict guardrails to prevent automated systems from exhausting client budget.
lessons.what_learner_does: Configure conversion actions, set bidding targets for a sample ₹30,000 budget, and audit automated search asset settings.
lessons.expected_outcome: Bidding Strategy & Automated Campaign Guardrails Specification.

lessons.lesson_title: Meta Ads Manager Hierarchy, Objectives & Audience Targeting
lessons.what_is_taught: Navigating Meta Ads Manager, ODAX campaign objectives, ad set configuration, placement optimization, and audience definitions.
subtopics: Meta Ads Manager hierarchy: Campaign (Objective) -> Ad Set (Audience, Budget, Placement) -> Ad (Creative & Copy)
Campaign Objectives under ODAX: Awareness, Traffic, Engagement, Leads, App Promotion, Sales
Audience targeting taxonomy: Core Audiences (location, demographics, detailed interests), Custom Audiences, Lookalike Audiences
Placement optimization: Advantage+ Placements vs. Manual Placements (Feeds, Stories, Reels)
Budget allocation models: Advantage Campaign Budget (CBO) vs. Ad Set Budget Optimization (ABO)
lessons.why_it_matters: Structuring ad sets and selecting appropriate campaign objectives ensures Meta's machine learning algorithm finds high-converting users efficiently.
lessons.what_learner_does: Set up a Meta campaign in draft mode, configure 2 distinct ad sets targeting local interest clusters and demographic profiles with manual placement testing.
lessons.expected_outcome: Meta Campaign Hierarchy & Audience Targeting Setup Workbook.

lessons.lesson_title: Meta Lead Generation, Instant Forms, Advantage+ & Ad Policy
lessons.what_is_taught: Building native instant lead generation forms, creative formatting, Advantage+ automation features, and platform policy compliance.
subtopics: Building Native Instant Forms: Intro banner, qualifying custom questions, prefill data, privacy policy link, completion screen
Creative formats: Single image ads, multi-card carousels, and vertical video ads
Advantage+ Creative enhancements: Text variations, visual touches, and aspect-ratio adjustments
Retargeting fundamentals: Custom audiences built from web visitors and social page engagement
Platform Advertising Policies: Prohibited content, personal attributes, health/finance claims, and avoiding account suspensions
Zero-spend verification: Testing and reviewing campaign drafts without connecting payment methods
lessons.why_it_matters: Native instant forms capture high-volume mobile leads without landing page load friction; policy compliance prevents devastating account bans.
lessons.what_learner_does: Build a native Meta Instant Form with custom qualifying questions, assemble 2 ad creative variants, and run an ad policy pre-flight check.
lessons.expected_outcome: Native Instant Lead Generation Form Build & Ad Policy Compliance Checklist.

modules.hands_on_practice: Build one Google Search campaign and one Meta lead-generation campaign using an authorized account, draft, or clearly labeled offline simulation.
modules.assignment: Student Deliverable 4: Google & Meta Advertising Campaign Project Evidence (comprehensive campaign build workbook, exported ad spreadsheets, draft preview screenshots, and compliance verification checklist).
modules.business_application: Core operational skill set required for Junior Paid Ads Executives, PPC Specialists, and Paid Social Media Buyers.
modules.expected_outcome: Verified dual-platform paid advertising build dossier complying with the Zero-Student-Ad-Spend Policy.

modules.module_purpose: Equip learners to design, edit, and optimize conversion-focused campaign landing pages, embed functional lead generation mechanisms, and test end-to-end customer conversion journeys.
what_you_will_learn: Understand the difference between general corporate websites and focused 1:1 campaign landing pages.
Construct and style responsive web pages in WordPress using core Gutenberg blocks.
Write benefit-driven conversion copy, establish CTA hierarchies, and integrate trust signals.
Embed functional lead generation forms with custom fields, thank-you pages, and lead magnets.
Implement UTM parameter campaign tracking and test end-to-end lead conversion flows.

lessons.lesson_title: Web Marketing Architecture & Landing Page Anatomy
lessons.what_is_taught: The strategic purpose of campaign landing pages, information architecture, mobile-first design principles, and conversion friction.
subtopics: Websites vs. Dedicated Campaign Landing Pages: The 1:1 attention ratio and elimination of navigation leaks
Anatomy of a high-converting landing page: Above-the-fold hero, value proposition, proof elements, benefit matrix, FAQ, footer CTA
Mobile-first responsive UX: Tap targets, sticky CTAs, readable typography, and page speed impacts on bounce rate
Psychological friction: Reducing visual clutter, cognitive overload, and anxiety in the conversion path
lessons.why_it_matters: Even high-performing paid ads will fail to generate revenue if the destination landing page confuses or frustrates mobile users.
lessons.what_learner_does: Wireframe a mobile-first campaign landing page layout, mapping content sections to user decision stages.
lessons.expected_outcome: Mobile-First Landing Page Wireframe & Information Architecture Plan.

lessons.lesson_title: WordPress Block Editing & Responsive Page Construction
lessons.what_is_taught: Navigating WordPress CMS, working with pages, themes, and plugins, and structuring landing pages with Gutenberg blocks.
subtopics: WordPress CMS core architecture: Pages vs. Posts, theme customizer, and plugin ecosystem
Building landing pages with WordPress Block Editor (Gutenberg): Columns, Groups, Covers, Spacers, Buttons
Utilizing lightweight block libraries and responsive visual controls
Configuring responsive breakpoints (desktop, tablet, mobile viewports)
lessons.why_it_matters: Enables digital marketers to rapidly build, iterate, and publish campaign landing pages without depending on web developers.
lessons.what_learner_does: Assemble and style a complete responsive campaign landing page inside a sandbox WordPress or LocalWP environment.
lessons.expected_outcome: Structured WordPress Landing Page Draft with Responsive Layouts.

lessons.lesson_title: Conversion Copywriting, CTA Hierarchy & Trust Signals
lessons.what_is_taught: Formulating benefit-driven headlines, establishing primary and secondary call-to-action hierarchies, and integrating social proof.
subtopics: Crafting compelling hero headlines and benefit-oriented subheadings that answer 'What's in it for me?'
Call to Action (CTA) hierarchy: Primary vs. Secondary buttons, button microcopy, and color contrast
Trust and credibility architecture: Customer testimonials, review star ratings, partner badges, and security seals
Risk reversal strategies: Guarantees, free trials, transparent pricing, and privacy reassurances
lessons.why_it_matters: Compelling conversion copy and prominent trust signals build the confidence required for users to submit personal contact data.
lessons.what_learner_does: Write all landing page copy sections, including hero headline variants, benefit bullet points, testimonial blocks, and button microcopy.
lessons.expected_outcome: Landing Page Conversion Copy Deck with Trust Signal Blueprint.

lessons.lesson_title: Lead Capture Forms, Thank-You Funnels & Lead Magnets
lessons.what_is_taught: Designing lead generation forms, balancing form friction with lead quality, configuring thank-you redirect funnels, and lead delivery.
subtopics: Designing high-converting lead capture forms: Field count vs. conversion rate optimization
Installing and configuring WordPress form plugins (WPForms / Fluent Forms)
Building dedicated Thank-You Pages: Setting expectations, next steps, and secondary conversion actions
Lead magnet delivery mechanisms: Direct file download redirects vs. automated confirmation email links
lessons.why_it_matters: The lead form and thank-you funnel represent the critical conversion bridge between anonymous visitor and actionable sales lead.
lessons.what_learner_does: Create and embed a working multi-field lead capture form on WordPress, configure input validation, and connect a custom Thank-You redirect page.
lessons.expected_outcome: Functional Lead Capture Form & Automated Thank-You Page Funnel.

lessons.lesson_title: UTM Parameter Tracking, Basic CRO & Journey Testing
lessons.what_is_taught: Constructing standard UTM campaign URLs, testing form-to-lead handoffs, introductory conversion rate optimization, and behavioral analysis.
subtopics: UTM parameter taxonomy: `utm_source`, `utm_medium`, `utm_campaign`, `utm_term`, `utm_content`
Building tracking URLs using the Google Campaign URL Builder
Introduction to Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): Diagnosing bounce rates and form abandonment
Introductory session observation with Microsoft Clarity (heatmaps, scroll depth, rage clicks)
End-to-end conversion journey testing: Form submission, email notification, redirect verification, and tracking parameter persistence
lessons.why_it_matters: Proper UTM tagging ensures accurate channel attribution in analytics, while journey testing guarantees no leads are lost to technical bugs.
lessons.what_learner_does: Generate 3 tagged campaign URLs, submit live test leads through the landing page, and audit notification delivery and redirect flow.
lessons.expected_outcome: UTM Tracking Sheet & Conversion Flow Verification Checklist.

modules.hands_on_practice: Build a campaign landing page with working forms and a testable lead conversion flow.
modules.assignment: Student Deliverable 2: Fully Functional, Optimized Campaign Landing Page (live staging URL or LocalWP export, with working lead form, thank-you page flow, and UTM tracking documentation).
modules.business_application: Crucial for inbound campaign execution, performance marketing coordination, and lead generation management.
modules.expected_outcome: Live, testable WordPress landing page ready to receive paid or organic marketing traffic.

modules.module_purpose: Provide practical, hands-on mastery over Google Analytics 4 (GA4), web conversion tracking via Google Tag Manager (GTM), data hygiene, and automated executive reporting in Looker Studio.
what_you_will_learn: Navigate GA4 properties, configure web data streams, and analyze Traffic Acquisition reports.
Understand the event-based data model, default events, and mark high-value events as Key Events.
Deploy Google Tag Manager (GTM) containers and configure custom click and form triggers.
Implement and test custom GA4 Event Tags in GTM Tag Assistant Preview mode on sandbox sites.
Calculate core marketing math formulas: CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA, and ROAS.
Build interactive single-page marketing dashboards connecting GA4 and Search Console in Looker Studio.

lessons.lesson_title: GA4 Architecture, Data Streams & Traffic Acquisition Reports
lessons.what_is_taught: The event-based measurement model of GA4, account and property hierarchy, web data streams, Enhanced Measurement, and acquisition reporting.
subtopics: Evolution from Universal Analytics session-based model to GA4 event-driven data model
Account structure: Accounts, GA4 Properties, and Web/App Data Streams
Enhanced Measurement: Automated capture of pageviews, 90% scrolls, outbound clicks, file downloads
Navigating Standard Reports: Acquisition, Engagement, Monetization, and Retention
Traffic Acquisition reporting: Default Channel Groups, Source / Medium, and campaign attribution basics
lessons.why_it_matters: GA4 is the global enterprise standard for web measurement; understanding its data model is essential for accurate marketing attribution.
lessons.what_learner_does: Navigate a GA4 property, inspect data stream settings, analyze traffic acquisition by source/medium, and compare session vs. user metrics.
lessons.expected_outcome: GA4 Traffic Acquisition Analysis & Data Stream Audit Report.

lessons.lesson_title: Google Tag Manager (GTM) Setup, Triggers & Event Tags
lessons.what_is_taught: The purpose of GTM, container architecture, tags, triggers, variables, and deploying custom GA4 event tags.
subtopics: Why use GTM: Decoupling marketing measurement tags from website source code
GTM Hierarchy: Accounts, Containers, Tags, Triggers, and Variables
Built-in Variables (Click URL, Click Classes, Page Path) and custom trigger types (All Clicks, Form Submission)
Deploying the Google Tag on a WordPress website via GTM
Creating custom GA4 Event Tags (e.g., `button_click`, `form_submit`, `generate_lead`)
Using GTM Preview & Debug Mode (Tag Assistant) to inspect tag firing status and trigger conditions
lessons.why_it_matters: GTM empowers marketers to instrument tracking events across websites without writing code or risking site downtime.
lessons.what_learner_does: Install GTM on a sandbox site, configure 3 custom event tags (phone click, CTA button click, form submit), and debug firing in Tag Assistant.
lessons.expected_outcome: Configured GTM Container Export (.json) & Tag Assistant Debug Log.

lessons.lesson_title: Key Events, Conversion Linking & Measurement Hygiene
lessons.what_is_taught: Marking GA4 Key Events (formerly conversions), linking Google Ads and Search Console, and measurement quality standards.
subtopics: The 'Key Events' terminology in GA4: Designating high-value user actions as Key Events
Linking GA4 with Google Ads and Google Search Console accounts
Importing GA4 Key Events into Google Ads for Smart Bidding optimization
Measurement hygiene: Internal traffic filtering (excluding agency/employee IP addresses)
Consent Mode v2 overview and privacy-compliant tracking fundamentals
Important operational rule: Google's public demo account is read-only; tagging must occur on student sandbox sites
lessons.why_it_matters: Clean, properly designated conversion data is mandatory for algorithmic ad bidding and reliable client reporting.
lessons.what_learner_does: Mark verified form submission events as Key Events in GA4, review account link settings, and configure internal IP filters.
lessons.expected_outcome: GA4 Key Event Configuration & Measurement Hygiene Plan.

lessons.lesson_title: Core Marketing Math, Commercial Metrics & ROAS Calculations
lessons.what_is_taught: Computational formulas, financial meaning, and diagnostic benchmarks for core commercial marketing metrics.
subtopics: CTR (Click-Through Rate) calculation: (Clicks / Impressions) x 100
CPC (Cost Per Click): Total Ad Spend / Total Clicks
CPL (Cost Per Lead) & CPA (Cost Per Acquisition): Total Cost / Total Conversions
ROAS (Return on Ad Spend): (Total Revenue Generated from Ads / Total Ad Spend) x 100%
Break-Even ROAS, Profit Margin analysis, and Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) vs. Lifetime Value (LTV)
lessons.why_it_matters: Marketing executives are judged on business revenue and acquisition profitability, not vanity engagement impressions.
lessons.what_learner_does: Solve a multi-channel performance calculation problem set, computing CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA, and ROAS across 3 sample client scenarios.
lessons.expected_outcome: Marketing Performance Mathematics & ROAS Calculation Workbook.

lessons.lesson_title: Looker Studio Dashboard Construction & Executive Reporting
lessons.what_is_taught: Connecting Looker Studio to data sources, designing executive dashboards, selecting visual chart types, and writing summary insights.
subtopics: Connecting Looker Studio to GA4 and Google Search Console data connectors
Dashboard layout principles: Scorecards, time-series traffic charts, channel acquisition tables, and device donut charts
Adding interactive date range controls and channel filter dropdowns
Data formatting, conditional formatting heatmaps, and brand styling
Drafting executive summary commentary: Translating data charts into actionable business recommendations
lessons.why_it_matters: Clients and corporate stakeholders expect clear, automated, visual dashboards rather than complex raw analytics tables.
lessons.what_learner_does: Build an interactive, single-page marketing dashboard in Looker Studio connecting live/sample GA4 data, complete with scorecards, charts, and date filters.
lessons.expected_outcome: Live Shareable Looker Studio Marketing Performance Dashboard.

modules.hands_on_practice: Using an authorized test website, implement and validate three important events, then build a simple marketing dashboard.
